@'
import numpy as np
import torch
from torch import nn
from actuator import Actuator
from teacher import stage, stage_cost
from solution import heat, lift, policy_cost
s=dict(C=120.,G=4.,time_scale_min=2.,time_origin_min=7.,y_shift_C=17.,y_scale_K=3.,Ta_C=21.)
z=torch.tensor([[0.2,0.3],[-0.4,0.5]],dtype=torch.float64)
w=nn.Parameter(torch.tensor(2.,dtype=z.dtype))
y=heat(lambda v: w*v[:,:1]**2+v[:,1:],z,s)
expected=3*2*w*z[:,:1]+4*(17+3*(w*z[:,:1]**2+z[:,1:])-21)-1000*z[:,1:]
torch.testing.assert_close(y,expected)
torch.testing.assert_close(torch.autograd.grad(y.sum(),w)[0],(6*z[:,:1]+12*z[:,:1]**2).sum())
assert heat(None,z,{}) is None and not z.requires_grad
rng=np.random.default_rng(19)
for n in [1,2,9,32]:
    s=dict(zip(('a','b','c','d','g'),rng.normal(size=5)))
    initial=rng.normal(size=3)
    increments=rng.normal(size=n)
    plant=Actuator(s,*initial[:2])
    outputs=[plant.step(u) for u in initial[-1]+increments.cumsum()]
    f,p=lift(s,n)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(f@initial+p@increments,outputs,rtol=1e-10,atol=1e-10)
cfg=dict(N=5,beta=.35,a=.86,b=-.22,limit=1.8,center=.32,scale=.7,q=1.5,r=.17,s=.4,discount=.81)
actor=nn.Linear(2,1,dtype=torch.float64)
with torch.no_grad():
    actor.weight.copy_(torch.tensor([[.34,-.25]],dtype=torch.float64))
    actor.bias.fill_(.12)
x=torch.tensor([[-5.],[.71],[1.6]],dtype=torch.float64)
ref=torch.tensor([[.2],[.1],[.15]],dtype=x.dtype)
prev=torch.tensor([[.25],[-.06],[.17]],dtype=x.dtype)
for coupled in [False,True]:
    def perception(v):
        assert coupled
        return .06*v[:,:1]-.12*v[:,1:]**2
    def oracle():
        def raw(v):
            return float(actor(torch.tensor(v,dtype=x.dtype)).detach())
        cost=0.
        for xi,ri,ui in zip(x.flatten().tolist(),ref.flatten().tolist(),prev.flatten().tolist()):
            for k in range(cfg['N']):
                nx,ua=stage(raw,xi,ri,ui,cfg)
                if coupled: nx+=.06*xi-.12*ua**2
                cost+=cfg['discount']**k*stage_cost(nx,ri,ua,ui,cfg)
                xi,ui=nx,ua
        return cost/len(x)
    value=policy_cost(actor,perception,x,ref,prev,cfg,coupled)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(value.detach().item(),oracle(),rtol=1e-12)
    grad=torch.autograd.grad(value,actor.bias)[0].item()
    with torch.no_grad():
        eps=1e-6
        actor.bias.add_(eps)
        upper=oracle()
        actor.bias.sub_(2*eps)
        lower=oracle()
        actor.bias.add_(eps)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(grad,(upper-lower)/(2*eps),rtol=1e-6,atol=1e-8)
print('PASS heat, lift, policy_cost')
